systems.system: Mobile-phone application for births managed by UNICEF
systems.country_label: aplicativo para telefones móveis gerido pela UNICEF
systems.tiers: the health plan of June 2023 says birth registration data are digitised through it and are not transferred to the health information system at INASA; it does not say who enters the data or whether the entry is the registration

systems.system: Birth registration in vaccination campaigns and maternal and child health services
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice with the Ministry of Public Health, under their partnership agreement
systems.tiers: the health ministry commits to collaborate in civil registration during vaccination campaigns and through maternal and child health services

note: Passages only. The plan calls the civil registry sub-system a grave weakness, with minimal coverage of deaths and births covered at 24% to 36%, and says the country has no functioning vital statistics system; the one digital tool it names is described too thinly to class, so no fact.
